sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
The chest rig is modeled after a Spiritus Systems LV-119 (in Wolf Grey) configured with a range of commercially available accessories from Spiritus Systems and other manufacturers. The carrier is outfitted with:
- Spiritus Systems Micro Fight Chassis Mk4 equipped with a Microfight MK2 Half Flap mounted to the front plate bag
- A Spiritus Systems Recovery Handle MK2 is mounted to the rear plate bag using a Petzl OK Carabiner
- Spiritus Systems Trifold Shoulder Covers for cable management
  - The placard carries three AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 W STANAG 30-round magazines, while the front utility pocket contains a Leatherman MUT EOD multitool, a Glock 9x19 17-round magazine, a paint marker, and two Cyalume infrared chemlights.
  - A North American Rescue C.A.T tourniquet is strapped to the bottom.
- Spiritus Systems MOLLE HLT Cummerbund, mounted with:
  - One Spiritus Systems JSTA Pouch loaded with one Glock 9x19 17-round magazine and one AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 W STANAG 30-round magazine
  - One Spiritus Systems Elastic Magazine Pouch (EMP) with one Magpul PMAG magazine
  - One Spiritus Systems Multi Platform Radio Chassis Mk5 carrying a Persistent Systems' MPU5 networking radio connected to a Push-to-Talk (PTT) adapter
  - One S&S Precision IZLID® Quick-Draw Pouch with a B.E. Meyers IZLID Ultra infrared laser emitter
  - Spiritus Systems Side Armor Bags.
